products.title: Vitassium Capsules
products.body_html: Vitassium Electrolyte Capsules were specifically created with the help of patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers for the daily management of certain types of dysautonomia like postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS), orthostatic hypotension (OH), and vasovagal syncope (VVS). Each 2-capsule serving contains 500mg of sodium and 100mg of potassium for a convenient way to meet your daily sodium goals.
